name: Gym Tracker
context: An iPhone app for the gym: see today's workout, log each set in a tap, rest with the countdown in front of you, get an achievable number for next time. Black ground, colour glowing down from the top, dot numbers.

pieces.title: Decided
items: Three spacings, one corner radius, four type sizes
One card per screen; the rest sits on the ground
Controls are white or dark, never coloured
Log first, rate the set while resting
